quarterly_data.quarter: Shijia Photons investor briefing Q&A: SSE Roadshow 39779 (06-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: At the investor briefing on terminating the planned purchase of control of Dongguan Fukexima Communication Technology, chairman Ge Haiquan, general manager Lv Kejin and board secretary Mei Xue said the termination was a prudent strategic decision that does not affect the two companies' existing cooperation: business dealings are normal, existing cooperation proceeds as agreed, and both will keep their upstream-downstream cooperative relationship. Ge said the company's high-speed optical chip and device development and industrialisation project is progressing steadily and was decided on market, industry and strategic grounds.

quarterly_data.quarter: Shijia Photons investor briefing Q&A: SSE Roadshow 39779 (06-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman Ge Haiquan and general manager Lv Kejin (investor briefing, June 1, 2026) on laser chips: 70-100mW CW DFB light sources for silicon-photonics modules have passed customer validation in the industry and reached small-batch shipments, with capacity planning and production-line deployment under way; R&D of the high-power CW light-source series is advancing and some high-power products have completed internal reliability validation; the 100G EML laser is still in customer validation and the 200G EML is in internal R&D testing. Lv said 1.6T AWG chips have reached small-batch shipments.
quarterly_data.figure: 70-100mW CW DFB small-batch shipments; 200G EML in internal testing
